title: Scaffold the separate Cloudflare Worker project
acceptance_criteria: A separate worker/ project has TypeScript, Wrangler, and test configuration with a minimal fetch entry point.
wrangler.jsonc defines the Worker entry point, compatibility settings, D1 binding, migration directory, and replaceable custom-domain configuration without real IDs or secrets.
PAIRING_SECRET and VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY are documented as encrypted secret bindings and no secret value appears in source, config, or frontend variables.
The scaffold type-checks without changing the existing web application or its local storage model.
completion_summary: Scaffolded separate typed Wrangler Worker with D1/migrations placeholders, custom-domain config, required encrypted secret bindings, minimal fetch entry point, and README.
